composition.arrows: An open routed contour with a distinct open arrowhead; join contributing inputs deliberately.
composition.people: An open head circle over an unfilled shoulder contour; omit face and gender cues.
composition.empty: An outlined chair with an unobstructed seat and an explicit empty label; no person silhouette.
composition.pending: A clock beside the pending object with an explicit pending label; never imply completion.
composition.emphasis: Use one small filled accent or junction rather than filling every object.
composition.warning: Combine a warning label and distinct accent mark; do not encode a fact only with color.

required.description: Keep open contours and quiet unfilled interiors; accent only the teaching point.
Preserve exact brief labels, locked relations and factual counts. Empty, pending and complete remain separate states. Inspect Japanese text at the actual placement.
Use the six semantic palette roles; every kit color-bearing element declares its role. Palette changes do not change geometry.
Use the scheme texture and fixed seed. Do not add random noise or distort text; no texture means no procedural texture.

preferred.description: Use upright labels outside silhouettes and preserve generous negative space.
Connector stroke may use the stronger connector role at narrow placement; inspect before reducing contours.

flexible.description: Panel count, object placement, arrow routing and line breaks follow the actual brief and aspect ratio; the reference is not a page template.
Hand-author tone-native variations or omit nonessential detail. Explain departures from preferred rules and retain required facts.
Use the declared Japanese font for essential labels; decorative Latin lettering may reflect the original reference when it remains readable.
